description: A single-panel figure consisting of one rendered table, with no sub-panels, axes, scale bars or legible graphical elements. The table is headed by a two-row header: the first row spans eight columns under the title "Alloy composition (wt.%)", and the second row names the eight elements — Al, Si, Mn, S, C, O, H, N — preceded by the identifying columns "Alloy" and "Process". Five data rows list the analysed ingots: Fe-7Al processed by AIM (Al 7.22, Si 0.20, Mn 0.056, S 0.0075, C 0.021, O 0.0200, H 0.0052, N 0.02); Fe-7Al AIMFC (Al 7.30, Si 0.14, Mn 0.045, S 0.0016, C 0.019, O 0.0057, H 0.0023, N 0.0018); Fe-7Al VIM (Al 7.02, Si 0.12, Mn 0.052, S 0.0028, C 0.015, O 0.0035, H 0.0020, N <0.001); Fe-9Al AIMFC (Al 9.20, Si 0.16, Mn 0.046, S 0.0015, C 0.017, O 0.0050, H 0.0052, N 0.0015); and Fe-9Al VIM (Al 9.10, Si 0.11, Mn 0.042, S 0.0027, C 0.014, O 0.0023, H 0.0021, N <0.001). The caption states that Fe-9Al produced by AIM is absent because that ingot contained a large amount of gas porosity, and that hydrogen analysis used an RH-444 Leco Gas analyzer. The table documents that AIMFC and especially VIM reduce O, H, S and N relative to AIM, establishing the compositional basis for comparing melting routes.

subfigures.description: One rendered table titled "Alloy composition (wt.%)" with columns Alloy, Process, Al, Si, Mn, S, C, O, H, N and five data rows (Fe-7Al AIM, Fe-7Al AIMFC, Fe-7Al VIM, Fe-9Al AIMFC, Fe-9Al VIM). No graphical panels, axes or scale bars.

observations.observation: The figure is a single table with the spanning header "Alloy composition (wt.%)" and element columns Al, Si, Mn, S, C, O, H, N.
Only two process routes are listed for the Fe-9Al alloy (AIMFC and VIM), whereas the Fe-7Al alloy is listed for all three routes (AIM, AIMFC, VIM).
Within Fe-7Al, AIM gives the highest interstitial/impurity levels (O 0.0200, H 0.0052, S 0.0075, N 0.02 wt.%) and VIM the lowest (O 0.0035, H 0.0020, S 0.0028, N <0.001 wt.%).
The caption states that the Fe-9Al alloy ingot produced by AIM exhibited a large amount of gas porosity and was therefore not analysed.
The caption states that hydrogen analysis was done by an RH-444 Leco Gas analyzer.
Si content decreases monotonically with the melting route in the order AIM > AIMFC > VIM for Fe-7Al (0.20, 0.14, 0.12 wt.%).
The table is Table I of the paper and carries no graphical panels, curves or micrographs.
